Eliza (Japanese: アリサ Arisa) is a character of the day who appeared in I Feel Skitty!. She runs The Greenhouse, a Pokémon aromatherapy laboratory.

After coming across a sick , and decided to take it to The Greenhouse. In reality, pitched the idea in order to meet her, having seen her on an infomercial earlier. Eliza didn't believe that Skitty was sick, just that it was tired. So she decided to make a special healing fragrance, which helped Skitty get its energy back.

Later, broke into The Greenhouse and stole many of her fragrances, as well as accidentally swiping Skitty. After they found Team Rocket's crashed balloon, Eliza called on her to use to try to lure Skitty out. and were lured out first, though Skitty eventually showed up and decided to go with .
